requirements: R1: The Playwright E2E test for document download produces visible test-run artifacts explicitly naming the e2e test scope verified.
R2: The Playwright E2E test successfully passes against a running backend instead of failing with an offline backend comment.

slices.title: Fix E2E test execution and artifact generation for catalog search
slices.jtbd: When implementing the E2E test fix for this epic, I want the test to pass and produce correctly scoped artifacts, so that the knowledge base download flow is demonstrably verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment pre-populated with sample Epidemiological Protocol documents, When the E2E test downloads a document, Then it correctly hits the system API and passes without offline failures.
Given the verification command runs, When the test suite completes, Then it produces visible test-run artifacts that explicitly name the e2e test scope verified.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce E2E test offline failure rate to 0%

requirements: R1: The task graph file patch writes the delivery plan exactly to the recorded output path in the payload.
R2: The generation script cleanly handles read-only or invalid target directories by exiting and logging the write error.

slices.title: Fix task graph patch output path and directory error handling
slices.jtbd: When implementing the build pipeline fix for this epic, I want the generation script to handle write errors cleanly and use the exact output path, so that the delivery plan is reliably saved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the malformed task graph file, When the patch is applied by the generation script, Then it is written exactly to the recorded output path in the payload.
Given the target directory is read-only or invalid, When the script attempts to write, Then it exits cleanly and logs the write error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce task graph generation write failure rate to 0%
